about: Mechanisms in MOC-183729 as chains of parts in the order motion flows. type = catalog/mechanisms.json, except sliding_dog_clutch which isn't in that library (see note on that mechanism). status per link: confirmed (seen in the booklet) or hypothesis.

mechanisms.name: Gearbox housing
mechanisms.does: Holds all three shafts (input, main, and the shift lever's pivot) at fixed spacing so the gears mesh correctly.

mechanisms.name: Shift lever mount
mechanisms.does: knob-I's ball stud is a lever attachment point; fork-J (fixed to the frame via pin-blue-E, not free to swing) holds it.
mechanisms.input: hand push on a lever (not included)
mechanisms.output: slide of fork-J's slot along the main shaft

chain.role: slotted housing, straddles the clutch sleeve

mechanisms.name: Input to main shaft
mechanisms.does: Turns the main shaft (axle-N) when the input shaft (axle-input-T) is turned by hand or motor.

chain.status: hypothesis (catalog match TURNS, not LOCKED -- see systems.json open_questions)

chain.role: main shaft, carries the clutch and both output gears

mechanisms.name: Two-position gear clutch
mechanisms.does: Not in catalog/mechanisms.json's library -- described here: a collar (sleeve-wht-Q + sleeve-blk-S) locked to a shaft so it always turns with it, but free to slide along the shaft's length inside a fork's slot. Sliding it against a neighboring free gear's clutch face locks that gear to the shaft; sliding it away frees the gear again.
mechanisms.input: slide of fork-J (from the shift lever)
mechanisms.output: whether gear-red-P turns with axle-N or spins free of it

chain.role: half of the sliding collar, locked to axle-N
other half of the sliding collar, locked to axle-N
free gear the sleeve can lock to the shaft

mechanisms.name: Output shaft
mechanisms.does: Carries the selected drive out through gear-tan-M, always locked to the main shaft.

review_note: The clutch_select mechanism's real job (pick between two different output speeds, vs. simple engage/disengage) is unconfirmed -- see sets/MOC-183729/systems.json open_questions. gear-gray-L being a LOCKED (not free) gear in the catalog match is the main contradiction: a classic 2-speed dog clutch needs two FREE gears to choose between, and only gear-red-P is confirmed free.
